evidence.title: Tracebit reports 773 assessments across seven models.
evidence.observation: Tracebit reports 773 assessments across seven models. In the GLM staged-encryption comparison, mean time to first objective rose from 4.0 to 31.2 minutes, while all 10 runs succeeded in each condition.

source_locations.SRC-029: Longer to the first objective; How we ran the tests; What the tests show

evidence.limitations: One controlled AWS environment, roughly 10 runs per model/scenario and two-hour limit. Time-to-first-objective averages condition on success; provider blocks, refusals and technical failures excluded. Results show delay can coexist with eventual success, not measured human intervention success.
evidence.open_questions: Generalization outside inspected settings and completeness/authenticity of underlying traces remain unestablished by the Commons.
evidence.support_assessment: Attributed bounded finding; publication inclusion does not certify truth or completeness. This is bounded counterevidence to inevitable compression of every available response window. Vendor study, no independent replication; full whitepaper email-gated and not obtained. No matching source or underlying case found among baseline v0.4.1 SRC-001–018 / CASE-001–017; recurring report mentions merge into this candidate, not corroboration.

terms.name: Chaperoning
terms.definition: The continuing supervisory activity of independently observing consequential behavior, exercising informed judgment, and intervening effectively when appropriate. This requires access, competence, authority, and an actual ability to alter outcomes—not nominal participation or an agent merely stating that an action is inappropriate.

terms.name: Horizon compression
terms.definition: A process in which the time available to identify, interpret, decide about, and intervene in consequential activity becomes shorter relative to the time intervention requires. It is an intervention-window problem, not a general label for every obstacle to correcting an agent.

relationships.explanation: Commons interpretation: The controlled staged-encryption comparison qualifies inevitable horizon-compression claims by delaying the first objective without preventing eventual success, while leaving effective defender intervention unmeasured.
Bounded illustrative connection of the attributed observation; material qualifications remain in limitations. No universal claim or definition change.
